response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack and backend software engineer with strong experience in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/cloud systems, but the resume shows no evidence of Japanese language proficiency (a hard requirement), no embedded/Linux kernel development, no C programming for UNIX/embedded security work, and no exposure to networking security technologies like MACsec, 802.1X, or L2/L3 switch operations. This is a fundamental mismatch with the role's core technical and language requirements.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated systems-level programming experience (DLang, C/C++ for NI LabWindows/CVI, low-latency async I/O)
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and open-source contributions
concerns: No mention of Japanese language proficiency, which is an explicit native-level requirement
No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel investigation/modification or embedded firmware development
No background in network security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, captive portal, switch chips) or embedded networking products

key_factors.factor: No embedded/Linux kernel security or C-for-UNIX experience
Strong general software engineering seniority and adaptability
